labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks how to get orange text; Rich already supports orange via named style colours (usage question).

body:
Rich already supports orange text through its style definitions. Named colours such as `orange1`, `dark_orange` and `orange3` are among the 256 colours, so `console.print("Hello", style="orange1")` prints orange. The [style documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst) covers colour names, hex and `color(<number>)` forms.

For usage questions like this one, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place. If the orange you need is not available in your terminal, say which colour and terminal you are using there.
